audit.whatIsWrong: The page gives Ryze a SHIELD in three places (whys[6], spikes[3], late) — he has none in the kit. It also says Locke 'can dodge Rune Prison' (whys[2]) and 'Rune Prison dodged with his dash' (wants.foe[0]); Rune Prison is a targeted 615-range cast that cannot be dodged, and the real limitation is that without Spell Flux on the target it only slows.
audit.why: This is the same calibration-grade fabrication the mirror caught on other Ryze pages. Telling a player his root can be dodged teaches the wrong counterplay to the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Shield references replaced with Overload spam; the root restated as unconditionally landing but only rooting through Spell Flux; his E named as a flat 10-second teleport-dash and its auto reset flagged as the burst tell.
sources: ownerKit Ryze W/E (no shield in kit)
